problem_text:
A logistics coordinator needs to load packages onto identical delivery trucks. The packages are as follows:

* Package Alpha: 48 kg
* Package Bravo: 56 kg
* Package Charlie: 58 kg
* Package Delta: 62 kg
* Package Echo: 48 kg
* Package Foxtrot: 34 kg
* Package Golf: 32 kg
* Package Hotel: 35 kg
* Package India: 52 kg
* Package Juliet: 54 kg
* Package Kilo: 56 kg
* Package Lima: 54 kg
* Package Mike: 70 kg
* Package November: 44 kg
* Package Oscar: 48 kg
* Package Papa: 61 kg
* Package Quebec: 55 kg
* Package Romeo: 65 kg
* Package Sierra: 30 kg
* Package Tango: 70 kg
* Package Uniform: 57 kg
* Package Victor: 70 kg
* Package Whiskey: 48 kg
* Package X-ray: 61 kg
* Package Yankee: 39 kg
* Package Zulu: 55 kg
* Package Asterisk: 57 kg
* Package Dash: 55 kg

Each truck has a maximum load capacity of 100 kg. Load all packages using the fewest number of trucks. Every package must be placed on exactly one truck, and the total weight loaded onto any truck cannot exceed its capacity.
